notes: SHORTLISTED 2026-11-13, his pick for the dining room (Andrew, 2026-11-13: "can I do something more colorful?", then, with a screenshot of this listing: "how about this blue 12\" for dining"). HANG: the dining room's right wall, on the table's long center line, its center 58 in off the floor (top edge about 64 in); the screw at 58 in plus the hanger-to-center distance measured on the clock (F-70). Why it works: a bright royal blue rim on a white face, crisp on the white walls and marble and more colorful than navy; the same maker, rim and face as the living room's Hunter Green 18 in (amazon-B0DHJHXLBD), so the two read as a deliberate pair in two colors and sizes; blue sits next to the green. Its numerals are a solid black serif, not the sans F-70 prefers, still easy to read at the table. Read 2026-11-13: $16.95, 4.4 stars (32,452), Amazon's Choice, Blue, 12 Inch, 1.34 lb, "Material Type Glass, Plastic" (a glass cover); FREE delivery Wed, Nov 18 on his screenshot; ships from Amazon, sold by Major Success. rooms: the brief.
